author: Kenny Nosay
title: Jaylen Brown Breaks Silence on Growing Noise Around His Dynamic With Jayson Tatum - NewsBreak
text:
By Kenny Nosay ,
1 hours ago
Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum (Photo by Imagn Images) Before Jayson Tatum debuted for the Boston Celtics this season, there were legitimate talks surrounding how he would get along with Jaylen Brown, especially on the leadership side of things .
Nobody expected the Celtics to be a playoff team this year. They lost key players via free agency. Plus, with Tatum initially expected to miss their entire campaign, the expectations were low – until Jaylen Brown surprised everybody by playing at an MVP level. Now that Tatum is back, people are starting to question whether Brown is comfortable playing a new role or stepping back going forward.
“We’ve accomplished a lot. We’ve won a lot and we one of the bigger profiles in the game, and it’s the Boston Celtics. So, anytime if one of us scratch our a** like it’s going to be on the news, right? You know what I mean, So, we are aware and we’re both on the same page,” Brown said in his appearance in ‘Cousins’.
“We had a good talk today about what we want the most. We both, you know, talk to the team as well, which is important. So, because I feel like the team kind goes off, we’ll go off what our energy is,” he added.
It looks like Jaylen Brown is tired of being asked whether he and Tatum can co-exist. He just wants to win and deliver another title for the Celtics.
Jaylen Brown Opens Up More About Tatum’s Return Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum (Photo by Imagn Images) It’s safe to say that the 29-year-old has established himself as the number one option for Boston this season. People tend to forget that Brown brought home the Finals MVP award in 2024. There’s no doubt he’s a superstar.
And based on one of his recent interviews, Jaylen Brown has no qualms about Jayson Tatum returning on the court this season. He knows that Tatum’s return will only boost Boston’s chances of winning another title this year and beyond.
